svg.title: Common ancestry: read the branch points
svg.desc: Root R splits into A and an ancestral lineage leading to S. S splits into B and C. B and C share a more recent common ancestor. Tip order carries no ranking.

g.text: Common ancestry: read the branch points
All tips are present-day lineages. Branch lengths are NOT time-scaled.
R: ancestor of A, B and C | S: more recent ancestor of B and C
A branching relationship, not a ladder of superiority or direct modern ancestors.
